sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手费尽心机来隐藏她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查清了她的名字叫阿达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认她的身份后，这起离奇的谋杀案反而变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“罪案档案呈现”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: warnings, please see the show notes for this episode on your app or on our website.
sentences.zh: 有关警告信息，请查看您使用的应用或我们网站上的本集节目说明。

sentences.en: This episode was originally released on Casefile's Patreon, Apple Premium and Spotify Premium feeds as an early bonus for our paid subscribers.
sentences.zh: 本集节目最初作为付费订阅用户的早期福利，发布在“罪案档案”的Patreon、Apple Premium和Spotify Premium频道上。

sentences.en: To receive these episodes early and ad-free, you can support Casefile on your preferred platform.
sentences.zh: 您可以在您偏好的平台上支持“罪案档案”，以便更早收听这些无广告的节目。

sentences.en: At approximately 7.40pm on Sunday, April 19, 2015, 9-1-1 dispatchers in New York State received a phone call from a distressed-sounding woman.
sentences.zh: 2015年4月19日星期日晚上7点40分左右，纽约州的911调度中心接到了一名听起来很绝望的女性打来的电话。

sentences.en: Strong winds and rolling waves could be heard in the background as the woman immediately explained,
sentences.zh: 电话背景中能听到呼呼的风声和起伏的波浪声，这名女子随即解释道：

sentences.en: I'm in the Hudson River by the Cornwall Yacht Club.
sentences.zh: 我在康沃尔游艇俱乐部附近的哈德逊河上。

sentences.en: My fiancé fell in the water.
sentences.zh: 我的未婚夫掉进水里了。

sentences.en: Can you please call anybody?
sentences.zh: 能请人去救救他吗？

sentences.en: The caller identified herself as Angelica She said that she and her fiancé Vincent had been kayaking back from Bannerman's Island
sentences.zh: 来电者自称是安洁莉卡（Angelica），她说她和未婚夫文森特（Vincent）当时正划着皮划艇从班纳曼岛返回

sentences.en: also known as Polipel Island, about 50 miles north of New York City when Vincent's kayak capsized
sentences.zh: 该岛也被称为波利佩尔岛，位于纽约市以北约50英里处，当时文森特的皮划艇翻了

sentences.en: He'd become separated from it and the current was pulling him south while the waves pushed Angelica in her kayak north
sentences.zh: 他与皮划艇失散了，水流正把他往南拉，而波浪则把安洁莉卡连同她的皮划艇往北推

sentences.en: I can't get to him, Angelica said
sentences.zh: 我过不去他那边，安洁莉卡说

sentences.en: It's very windy and the waves are coming in.
sentences.zh: 风非常大，浪也在涌上来。

sentences.en: I can't paddle to him.
sentences.zh: 我划不过去他那里。

sentences.en: He's getting further and further away from me.
sentences.zh: 他离我越来越远了。

sentences.en: He's going to drown.
sentences.zh: 他要淹死了。

sentences.en: Please call somebody.
sentences.zh: 请叫人来救救他。

sentences.en: The dispatcher urged Angelica to stay calm, reassuring her that help was on the way.
sentences.zh: 调度员敦促安洁莉卡保持冷静，并向她保证救援人员正在赶往现场。

sentences.en: Angelica said she could still see Vincent's head above the water but warned that it was getting very bad as the distance between them grew.
sentences.zh: 安洁莉卡说她还能看到文森特露出水面的头部，但警告说随着两人距离拉开，情况变得非常糟糕。

sentences.en: She revealed that Vincent wasn't wearing a life jacket but was clinging to a small buoyant cushion from his kayak.
sentences.zh: 她透露文森特没有穿救生衣，而是紧紧抓着他皮划艇上的一个小浮力垫。

sentences.en: Hold on baby, she shouted to him.
sentences.zh: 坚持住，宝贝，她朝着他大喊。

sentences.en: As time wore on, Angelica's panic escalated.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，安洁莉卡的恐慌情绪不断升级。

sentences.en: She suddenly screamed, oh my god, I can't see him anymore.
sentences.zh: 她突然尖叫起来，天哪，我看不见他了。

sentences.en: Angelica said she could see a rescue boat approaching, but found little comfort in its arrival.
sentences.zh: 安洁莉卡说她看到一艘救援船正在靠近，但船只的到来并没有给她带来多少安慰。

sentences.en: I'm not worried about myself, she told the dispatcher.
sentences.zh: 我不担心我自己，她对调度员说。

sentences.en: I'm worried about Vince.
sentences.zh: 我担心文斯。

sentences.en: I think he drowned.
sentences.zh: 我想他已经溺水了。

sentences.en: I need him to be rescued.
sentences.zh: 我需要他被救上来。

sentences.en: Then, without warning, the harrowing 15-minute call abruptly cut off.
sentences.zh: 接着，毫无征兆地，这通令人揪心的15分钟电话突然中断了。

sentences.en: A civilian rescue boat from the Cornwall Yacht Club raced toward the unfolding emergency on the Hudson River.
sentences.zh: 一艘来自康沃尔游艇俱乐部的民间救援船朝着哈德逊河上正在发生的紧急情况疾驰而去。

sentences.en: By this point, the sun had almost set and the wind was picking up as a storm approached.
sentences.zh: 此时太阳几乎已经落山，随着暴风雨临近，风力也越来越大。

sentences.en: Chilled by recent mountain snowmelt, the Hudson was a brisk 46 degrees Fahrenheit, or just under 8 degrees Celsius.
sentences.zh: 受到近期融化的山地雪水影响，哈德逊河水冰凉，仅有46华氏度（即不到8摄氏度）。

sentences.en: Its surface was choppy, with swells reaching 3 to 4 feet high.
sentences.zh: 河面波涛汹涌，浪高达到3到4英尺。

sentences.en: As the rescuers navigated the treacherous conditions, they wondered why anyone in their right mind would have chosen to go kayaking that evening.
sentences.zh: 救援人员在恶劣的环境中艰难前行，他们纳闷为什么脑子正常的人会选择在那天晚上去划皮划艇。

sentences.en: They soon spotted 35-year-old Angelika Graswold struggling in the rough, frigid waters.
sentences.zh: 不久，他们发现了35岁的安洁莉卡·格拉斯沃尔德（Angelika Graswold），她正在波涛汹涌、冰冷刺骨的水中挣扎。
zh_words: 安洁莉卡·格拉斯沃尔德

sentences.en: She was bolstered by a life jacket while her red kayak drifted nearby, overturned in the waves.
sentences.zh: 她靠着救生衣支撑着，而她的红色皮划艇则在附近漂浮着，在波浪中翻了个底朝天。

sentences.en: The rescuers pulled Angelika to safety but couldn't see anyone else in the river.
sentences.zh: 救援人员将安洁莉卡拉上岸脱险，但在河里看不到其他人。

sentences.en: Once ashore, the cold and distressed Angelica was rushed to the hospital where she was treated for hypothermia
sentences.zh: 上岸后，寒冷且惊恐万状的安洁莉卡被紧急送往医院，并在那里接受了低体温症的治疗

sentences.en: A life-threatening condition caused by exposure to cold temperatures resulting in the body losing heat faster than it can produce it
sentences.zh: 这是一种因暴露在寒冷环境中导致身体散热快于产热而引发的危及生命的病症

sentences.en: Though visibly shaken and in shock, Angelica was able to tell the police about the events that had taken place that day
sentences.zh: 尽管明显受到惊吓且处于休克状态，安洁莉卡还是能够向警方讲述当天发生的事情

sentences.en: Kayaking on the Hudson was a springtime tradition for herself and her 46-year-old fiancée, Vincent Villafor
sentences.zh: 在哈德逊河上划皮划艇是她与46岁未婚夫文森特·维拉福尔（Vincent Viafore）的春季传统

sentences.en: It was their mutual love for outdoor adventure that had partly drawn the pair together in the first place
sentences.zh: 正是两人对户外冒险的共同热爱，当初在一定程度上将他们吸引到了一起

sentences.en: Vincent, known to his friends as Vince or Vinnie, grew up by the Hudson River and had a deep love for all things water-related
sentences.zh: 文森特的朋友们叫他文斯（Vince）或维尼（Vinnie），他在哈德逊河畔长大，对所有与水相关的事物有着深厚的热爱

sentences.en: Be it fishing, swimming or water sports
sentences.zh: 无论是钓鱼、游泳还是水上运动

sentences.en: Vincent had taken up kayaking with his first wife, a hobby they'd enjoyed together until their amicable split.
sentences.zh: 文森特曾和他的第一任妻子一起开始划皮划艇，这是他们俩在和平分手前一直很享受的爱好。

sentences.en: His passion for the sport remained and he continued to hone his skills over the years, with the Hudson River becoming one of his favourite places to paddle.
sentences.zh: 他对这项运动的热情依然不减，多年来不断磨练自己的技能，哈德逊河也成了他最喜欢划船的地方之一。

sentences.en: Angelika had grown up in Latvia, where her childhood was defined by camping, volleyball, swimming and fishing.
sentences.zh: 安洁莉卡在拉脱维亚长大，她的童年伴随着露营、排球、游泳和钓鱼。

sentences.en: Like Vincent, she was a seasoned kayaker, and the two hit the water so frequently that they kept their kayaks in their living room.
sentences.zh: 和文森特一样，她也是个经验丰富的皮划艇手，两人下水的频率如此之高，以至于把皮划艇放在客厅里。

sentences.en: Angelica told the police that she and Vincent were nursing hangovers that Sunday, but the unseasonably warm weather convinced them to squeeze in their
sentences.zh: 安洁莉卡告诉警察，她和文森特那个星期天都有宿醉，但反常的温暖天气说服他们抓紧时间

sentences.en: first kayaking trip of the season.
sentences.zh: 进行本季的首次皮划艇之旅。

sentences.en: While they knew a storm was forecast for later that night, they fully intended to finish their outing before then.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们知道预报说那天晚些时候会有风暴，但他们完全打算在那之前结束出行。

sentences.en: Their plan was to kayak to Bannermans Island, which was named after the ruins of an abandoned military surplus warehouse built there in 1901.
sentences.zh: 他们的计划是划皮划艇去班纳曼岛，该岛因1901年建在那里的废弃军事剩余物资仓库废墟而得名。

sentences.en: The uninhabited island, which was roughly 1,000 feet from the river's eastern shore, was only accessible by boat and off-limits to visitors outside scheduled tours
sentences.zh: 这座无人居住的岛屿距离河东岸约1000英尺，只能乘船到达，由于废墟脆弱且危险的状况，

sentences.en: due to the fragile and hazardous condition of the ruins.
sentences.zh: 在预定参观时间之外不对游客开放。

sentences.en: However, Angelica was intimately familiar with the area
sentences.zh: 然而，安洁莉卡对这个地区非常熟悉

sentences.en: For the past three years she had volunteered as a gardener with the island's Preservation Society
sentences.zh: 过去三年里，她一直担任该岛保护协会的志愿园丁

sentences.en: She tended to the island every Wednesday and had formed close friendships with its caretakers
sentences.zh: 她每周三都会去打理该岛，并与那里的看守人结下了深厚的友谊

sentences.en: She adored its natural beauty and rich, ornate history
sentences.zh: 她喜爱这里自然美景和丰富华丽的历史

sentences.en: Its crown jewel, the remnants of the Scottish-inspired Bannermans Castle reminded her of the architecture in Latvia.
sentences.zh: 其皇冠上的明珠——带有苏格兰风格的班纳曼城堡遗迹让她想起了拉脱维亚的建筑。

sentences.en: Despite the restrictions on visiting the island,
sentences.zh: 尽管有参观该岛的限制，

sentences.en: Angelika and Vincent ventured out there anyway.
sentences.zh: 安洁莉卡和文森特还是冒险去了那里。

sentences.en: Angelika said she showered as Vincent packed their car with their kayaks, two 8'6 Clearwater Affinities.
sentences.zh: 安洁莉卡说她在冲澡，而文森特则把他们的皮划艇——两艘8尺6寸的清水亲和号（Clearwater Affinities）装进车里。

sentences.en: Both were Fusion 124 models, hers red, his blue.
sentences.zh: 两者都是Fusion 124型号，她的红色，他的蓝色。

sentences.en: Angelika's kayak was stored inside the vehicle, while Vincent's was strapped to the roof.
sentences.zh: 安洁莉卡的皮划艇存放在车内，而文森特的则绑在车顶上。

sentences.en: They set off from their apartment in the riverside city of Poughkeepsie and drove 30 minutes south to their destination,
sentences.zh: 他们从河滨城市波基浦西（Poughkeepsie）的公寓出发，向南驱车30分钟到达目的地，

sentences.en: stopping at a fast food restaurant for a quick bite along the way.
sentences.zh: 途中在一家快餐店停下来简单吃了一口。

sentences.en: It was a little after 4pm when the couple launched their kayaks from Plum Point Park, located on the eastern shore of the
sentences.zh: 那天过下午4点，这对夫妇从位于哈德逊河东岸的

sentences.en: Hudson River.
sentences.zh: 普拉姆角公园（Plum Point Park）下水划起了皮划艇。

sentences.en: The water was calm, although colder than they anticipated.
sentences.zh: 河水很平静，只是比他们预期的要冷。

sentences.en: Angelica took her purse with her cell phone, while Vincent brought a waterproof bag containing a camera and a couple of beers.
sentences.zh: 安洁莉卡带了装有手机的手提包，而文森特则带了一个防水袋，里面装有一台相机和几瓶啤酒。

sentences.en: According to Angelica, neither of them typically wore a life jacket, but this time,
sentences.zh: 据安洁莉卡说，他们俩平时都不穿救生衣，但这一次，

sentences.en: Vincent convinced her to wear hers.
sentences.zh: 文森特说服她穿上了救生衣。

sentences.en: He didn't own one, so he went without.
sentences.zh: 他自己没有救生衣，所以就没穿。

sentences.en: The journey to Bannerman's Island was expected to take 30 to 45 minutes at a moderate pace.
sentences.zh: 以适中的速度计算，去班纳曼岛的行程预计需要30到45分钟。

sentences.en: As they paddled, the couple admired the scenic beauty of the Hudson Valley with Breakneck Ridge to the east and Storm King Mountain to the weSt.
sentences.zh: 在划桨时，这对夫妇欣赏着哈德逊河谷的美丽风光，东边是断颈岭（Breakneck Ridge），西边是暴风王山（Storm King Mountain）。

sentences.en: Bannerman's Castle, with its lush garden surroundings, provided the perfect backdrop for a photo shoot the couple had planned that day.
sentences.zh: 班纳曼城堡及其周围郁郁葱葱的花园，为这对夫妇那天计划的照片拍摄提供了完美的背景。

sentences.en: Angelica was an avid nature photographer.
sentences.zh: 安洁莉卡是一名热心的自然摄影师，

sentences.en: and Vincent shared her love for capturing special moments.
sentences.zh: 而文森特也和她一样热爱捕捉特殊时刻。

sentences.en: They were considering using the island for their upcoming wedding photos.
sentences.zh: 他们正考虑将这座岛用于他们即将到来的婚纱照。

sentences.en: The trip to the island was smooth and uneventful.
sentences.zh: 去岛上的旅程很顺利，没有发生什么意外。

sentences.en: Once there, they pulled their kayaks ashore and climbed the stairs to explore the castle ruins.
sentences.zh: 到达那里后，他们把皮划艇拉上岸，爬上台阶去探索城堡遗迹。

sentences.en: They had originally planned a sexy photo shoot featuring Angelica in lingerie, fishnet stockings and heels, but the unexpectedly cold temperature caused them to rethink the idea.
sentences.zh: 他们原本计划进行一场性感的照片拍摄，安洁莉卡身穿内衣、渔网袜和高跟鞋，但出乎意料的低温让他们重新考虑了这个想法。

sentences.en: Instead, they wandered around, enjoyed their beers, and took candid photos of one another.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们四处闲逛，喝着啤酒，互相拍了些抓拍照片。

sentences.en: Their initial plan was to paddle around to the other side of the island, but as the sun began to set, they decided to head back to the mainland instead.
sentences.zh: 他们最初的计划是划到岛的另一侧，但随着太阳开始落山，他们决定转而返回大陆。

sentences.en: By the time they were halfway across the river, the tide had shifted and the forecasted storm was rolling in.
sentences.zh: 当他们划到河中央时，潮水已经转向，预报中的风暴也正席卷而来。

sentences.en: The growing wind and waves made the return trip far more strenuous.
sentences.zh: 不断增强的风浪使得返程变得更加费力。

sentences.en: Vincent remained upbeat as he paddled ahead of Angelica, navigating the rolling waves with his usual playful spirit.
sentences.zh: 文森特在安洁莉卡前方划桨时依然保持着乐观的心态，他带着惯常顽皮的精神在起伏的波浪中穿行。

sentences.en: Baby, this is an adventure of a lifetime, he called out.
sentences.zh: 宝贝，这是一次一生难忘的冒险，他大声喊道。

sentences.en: But Angelica's concerns were mounting
sentences.zh: 但安洁莉卡的担忧却在不断增加

sentences.en: The waves were splashing into the cockpit of Vincent's kayak
sentences.zh: 波浪正拍打进文森特皮划艇的驾驶舱

sentences.en: Causing it to flood and dry to lower in the water
sentences.zh: 导致它进水并在水中越沉越低

sentences.en: His kayak became increasingly unstable And he struggled in the rough conditions
sentences.zh: 他的皮划艇变得越来越不稳定，他在恶劣的环境中艰难挣扎

sentences.en: Suddenly, Vincent's kayak flipped
sentences.zh: 突然，文森特的皮划艇翻了

sentences.en: Throwing him into the cold, dark water
sentences.zh: 把他甩进了解冰冷黑暗的水中

sentences.en: Angelica watched in horror as he clung to his kayak and its buoyant seat cushion.
sentences.zh: 安洁莉卡惊恐地看着他紧紧抓住皮划艇及其带有浮力的座椅垫。

sentences.en: Just hold on, Angelica yelled, as she grabbed Vincent's wayward paddle from the river and secured it to her own kayak.
sentences.zh: 坚持住，安洁莉卡大喊着，她从河里抓起文森特失落的船桨，并把它固定在自己的皮划艇上。

sentences.en: She tried to paddle toward him, but the gusty wind and choppy waves kept pushing them further apart.
sentences.zh: 她试图朝他划过去，但阵风和汹涌的波浪不断把他们推得越来越远。

sentences.en: Though Vincent was athletic and a strong swimmer, the powerful current and dicey water made it difficult for him to stay afloat.
sentences.zh: 尽管文森特热爱运动且水性很好，但强大的水流和危险的水域让他很难浮在水面上。

sentences.en: I don't think I am going to make it, he shouted.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我撑不下去了，他大喊道。

sentences.en: Unwilling to imagine the alternative, Angelica replied with optimism.
sentences.zh: 安洁莉卡不愿去想另一种可能，于是乐观地回答道。

sentences.en: What are you talking about?
sentences.zh: 你在说什么呢？

sentences.en: You're going to make it, of course.
sentences.zh: 你当然能撑过去。

sentences.en: Vincent watched on as Angelica fought a losing battle to reach him.
sentences.zh: 文森特眼看着安洁莉卡做着徒劳的挣扎试图靠近他。

sentences.en: Soon, he lost contact with his sinking kayak and was left clinging only to the small seat cushion.
sentences.zh: 很快，他与下沉的皮划艇失去了联系，只剩下那个小座椅垫可以抓握。

sentences.en: Realising the gravity of the situation, he yelled at Angelica to call 911
sentences.zh: 意识到情况的严重性，他大喊让安洁莉卡拨打911

sentences.en: While Angelica was speaking to the operator, she too was thrown into the water
sentences.zh: 正当安洁莉卡与接线员通话时，她自己也被甩入了水中

sentences.en: Losing her cell phone into its icy depth as she went
sentences.zh: 落水时，她的手机掉进了冰冷的深水区不见了

sentences.en: Her life jacket kept her afloat, but she had lost sight of Vincent entirely
sentences.zh: 她的救生衣使她浮在水面上，但她完全失去了文森特的踪影

sentences.en: The police sympathised with Angelica as the search for her fiancé intensified

sentences.zh: 警方不得不重申这次预约的重要性，并强调这应该优先处理，随后安杰利卡才道歉并在当天晚些时候赶来与他们交谈。

sentences.en: The police knew that people coped with the trauma and grief differently sometimes in ways that didn't entirely make sense.
sentences.zh: 警方知道人们应对创伤和悲伤的方式各不相同，有时甚至会有一些完全让人无法理解的方式。

sentences.en: They treated Angelica kindly, apologising profusely for making her relive her painful experience in order to assist their investigation.
sentences.zh: 他们对安杰利卡态度温和，为让她为了协助调查而重温痛苦经历一再道歉。

sentences.en: Angelica told them she understood why they wanted to question her, saying that the incident had occurred under, quote, suspicious circumstances.
sentences.zh: 安杰利卡告诉他们，她理解他们为什么要讯问她，并称这起事件发生时带有“引述”可疑的情况。

sentences.en: The police asked what she meant by that.
sentences.zh: 警方问她这话是什么意思。

sentences.en: She didn't provide a clear answer and instead steered the conversation in a different direction
sentences.zh: 她没有给出明确的回答，而是把话题引向了另一个方向。

sentences.en: Throughout the police interview, Angelica smoked cigarettes, breathed heavily and repeatedly mentioned that she didn't feel well
sentences.zh: 在整个警察讯问过程中，安杰利卡一直在抽烟、呼吸急促，并反复提到她感觉身体不舒服。

sentences.en: At the end, she offered the interviewing detective a $10 Google Play gift card as a thank you for his help
sentences.zh: 最后，她送给负责讯问的警探一张10美元的谷歌应用商店礼品卡，作为对他的帮助的谢礼。

sentences.en: When he explained that he couldn't accept it, she attempted to give him a homemade figurine which he also declined.
sentences.zh: 当警探解释说他不能接受时，她又试图送给他一个自制小雕像，也被他拒绝了。

sentences.en: On her way out, she was overheard asking a companion if they would go out with her that night for a steak and some wine.
sentences.zh: 在她离开时，有人无意中听到她问同伴，当晚要不要和她一起出去吃牛排喝红酒。

sentences.en: Suspicions toward Angelica heightened when a rescuer from the Cornwall Yacht Club stated that they believed she had intentionally flipped her
sentences.zh: 当康沃尔游艇俱乐部的一名搜救人员表示，他们认为她在他们到达前不久是故意翻船的时，

sentences.en: kayak just moments before they arrived.
sentences.zh: 人们对安杰利卡的怀疑加剧了。

sentences.en: Then there was the matter of the cell phone Angelica had used to call 911 on the night Vincent disappeared.
sentences.zh: 还有就是安杰利卡在文森特失踪当晚用来拨打911的那部手机的问题。

sentences.en: She claimed to have lost it in the water when she capsized, but an eyewitness from the rescue boat reported seeing it in her possession as they headed to shore.
sentences.zh: 她声称手机在翻船时落水丢失了，但搜救船上的一名目击者报告说，在他们驶向岸边时，看到手机还在她手里。

sentences.en: Some of Vincent's friends were also dubious about
sentences.zh: 文森特的一些朋友也对

sentences.en: Angelica's version of events.
sentences.zh: 安杰利卡的事件版本表示怀疑。

sentences.en: While they acknowledged that Vincent could be a bit of an adrenaline junkie, they also knew that he always took precautions.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们承认文森特有时有点追求刺激，但他们也知道他总是会采取预防措施。

sentences.en: One friend remarked that
sentences.zh: 一位朋友评论说，

sentences.en: Angelica's account, quote, just didn't jibe with me.
sentences.zh: 安杰利卡的陈述“引述”根本对不上号。

sentences.en: But there was no clear motive for Angelica wanting Vincent out of the picture, at least not initially.
sentences.zh: 但安杰利卡想要文森特消失并没有明显的动机，至少最初是没有的。

sentences.en: It wasn't until the police spoke with
sentences.zh: 直到警方与

sentences.en: Vincent's sister that they uncovered a startling detail.
sentences.zh: 文森特的姐姐谈过之后，他们才发现了一个惊人的细节。

sentences.en: Six months before Vincent disappeared,
sentences.zh: 在文森特失踪前六个月，

sentences.en: Angelica had become the primary beneficiary of two of his life insurance policies, with a combined total of $550,000.
sentences.zh: 安杰利卡成了他两份人寿保险的主要受益人，总额高达55万美元。

sentences.en: Vincent told his sister that he'd made the change in order to designate Angelica as his domestic partner so she could be added to his health insurance plan.
sentences.zh: 文森特告诉他姐姐，他做此更改是为了将安杰利卡指定为他的家庭伴侣，这样她就可以被添加到他的健康保险计划中。

sentences.en: However, after Vincent went missing, Angelica had reportedly talked about what she could do with the money.
sentences.zh: 然而，在文森特失踪后，据报道安杰利卡曾讨论过她可以用这些钱做些什么。

sentences.en: As police dug further, they discovered that Angelica had a tendency to become violent with
sentences.zh: 随着警方深入挖掘，他们发现安杰利卡在喝醉酒时

sentences.en: Vincent when she was drunk.
sentences.zh: 对文森特有暴力倾向。

sentences.en: She had been witnessed slapping him hard across the face multiple times.
sentences.zh: 曾有人目击她狠狠地扇了他好几记耳光。

sentences.en: Vincent never reacted, but just looked at her and remained calm.
sentences.zh: 文森特从未反抗，只是看着她并保持平静。

sentences.en: Two weeks before the kayaking accident, Vincent texted a friend expressing doubts about his relationship, admitting that he didn't think it was going to work out.
sentences.zh: 就在皮划艇事故发生前两周，文森特给朋友发短信表达了他对这段感情的疑虑，承认他觉得这段感情不会有什么结果。

sentences.en: The next day he had a change of heart, saying that Angelica had become so afraid of losing him that they had managed to sort their problems out.
sentences.zh: 第二天他改变了主意，称安杰利卡变得非常害怕失去他，以至于他们设法解决了彼此的问题。

sentences.en: While Vincent's long-term position as a project manager with the state of
sentences.zh: 虽然文森特作为纽约州项目经理的长期职位

sentences.en: New York paid well, it emerged that he'd been struggling financially and had even declared bankruptcy in 2010.
sentences.zh: 薪水不错，但据透露他一直在经济上苦苦挣扎，甚至在2010年申请了破产。

sentences.en: His liabilities far exceeded his assets, with a deficit of more than $26,000.
sentences.zh: 他的负债远超资产，赤字超过2.6万美元。

sentences.en: As a result, his Jeep Grand Cherokee Sport Utility Vehicle and Stingray Powerboat had been repossessed.
sentences.zh: 因此，他的吉普大切诺基运动型多功能车和黄貂鱼摩托艇都被扣押了。

sentences.en: These financial issues seemed to have impacted Vincent's relationship with
sentences.zh: 这些经济问题似乎影响了文森特与

sentences.en: Angelica.
sentences.zh: 安杰利卡的感情。

sentences.en: According to friends of the couple, Vincent had postponed their wedding several times.
sentences.zh: 据这对情侣的朋友称，文森特曾多次推迟婚礼。

sentences.en: Eventually, he gave Angelica an ultimatum, find a job by the end of the month, or he would kick her out of his apartment.
sentences.zh: 最终，他给安杰利卡下了最后通牒：月底前找到工作，否则他就把她赶出公寓。

sentences.en: When the search for Vincent Viafor's body reached its ninth fruitless day, investigators contacted Angelica to inform her of their plans to return to Bannerman's Island
sentences.zh: 当搜寻文森特·维亚福遗体的行动进入第九天却一无所获时，调查人员联系了安杰利卡，告知她他们计划重返班纳曼岛

sentences.en: for a more thorough examination of the site.
sentences.zh: 对现场进行更彻底的勘查。

sentences.en: Oh good, she replied.
sentences.zh: “太好了，”她回答道。

sentences.en: Maybe I'll see you out there.
sentences.zh: “也许我会在那边碰见你们。”

sentences.en: Angelica intended to lay a wreath in the water as a tribute to Vincent.
sentences.zh: 安杰利卡打算在水中放置一个花圈，以此来悼念文森特。

sentences.en: The following morning, three case detectives conducted a search of the island as planned but found nothing of significance.
sentences.zh: 次日上午，三名案件侦查员按计划对该岛进行了搜查，但没有发现任何重大线索。

sentences.en: Angelica arrived at around noon.
sentences.zh: 安杰利卡于中午左右抵达。

sentences.en: She greeted the waiting detectives with hugs before they asked her to retrace her steps from the day Vincent vanished.
sentences.zh: 她与等候在现场的侦查员拥抱致意，随后他们要求她重现文森特失踪当天的行踪。

sentences.en: During Angelica's reenactment, the detectives highlighted the inconsistencies they had uncovered in her story, including the conflicting accounts about her dropping her cell phone.
sentences.zh: 在安杰利卡重现情景的过程中，侦查员指出了她在供述中发现的前后矛盾之处，包括关于她丢手机的冲突说法。

sentences.en: In response, Angelica's behaviour grew increasingly erratic.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，安杰利卡的行为变得越来越反复无常。

sentences.en: She appeared to lose focus and chain-smoked two cigarettes before clutching her stomach as though in pain and repeatedly asking to use the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 她显得注意力不集中，连续抽了两支烟，随后双手紧捂腹部，面露痛苦之色，并反复要求去洗手间。

sentences.en: Eventually, she began to cry.
sentences.zh: 最终，她哭了起来。

sentences.en: Angelica, something is not right, one of the detectives said.
sentences.zh: “安杰利卡，有些不对劲，”其中一名侦查员说道。

sentences.en: You are not being honest with us.
sentences.zh: “你对我们并不诚实。”

sentences.en: It's important to tell the truth.
sentences.zh: 说出真相很重要。

sentences.en: We need to know what happened.
sentences.zh: 我们需要知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: Angelica agreed but said that she wasn't ready.
sentences.zh: 安杰利卡表示同意，但称她还没准备好。

sentences.en: She was asked if she would feel more comfortable speaking with the detective alone rather than in front of the group.
sentences.zh: 有人问她，单独与侦查员交谈是不是会比在一群人面前觉得更自在一些。

sentences.en: She agreed and Detective Donald DeQuarto was selected to speak with her privately.
sentences.zh: 她同意了，于是唐纳德·德夸托侦查员被选中与她私下交谈。

sentences.en: The pair had a near hour-long conversation before Detective DeQuarto regrouped with the other investigators and announced,
sentences.zh: 两人进行了近一个小时的谈话，随后德夸托侦查员重新加入其他调查人员的行列并宣布：

sentences.en: You're not going to believe this
sentences.zh: 你们绝对不会相信这一点。

sentences.en: According to De Quarto, when he and Angelica were alone, she sat down and lit another cigarette
sentences.zh: 据德夸托称，当他和安杰利卡单独在一起时，她坐下来又点了一支烟。

sentences.en: De Quarto firmly told Angelica
sentences.zh: 德夸托坚定地对安杰利卡说：

sentences.en: Just tell me what's going on
sentences.zh: “直接告诉我到底怎么回事。”

sentences.en: She replied cryptically
sentences.zh: 她神秘地回答道：

sentences.en: You know about the plug, right?
sentences.zh: “你知道那个塞子对吧？”

sentences.en: But Detective De Quarto had no idea what Angelica was talking about and asked her to tell him more.
sentences.zh: 但德夸托侦查员根本不知道安杰利卡在说什么，便让她多讲一点。

sentences.en: Angelica responded,
sentences.zh: 安杰利卡回应道：

sentences.en: She was referring to the drain plug, a small but crucial part located on the top side of the stern above the waterline.
sentences.zh: 她指的是排水塞，这是位于船尾水线以上顶部的一个小而关键的部件。

sentences.en: Drain plugs are screwed into place and removed on dry land to expel water that's caught inside the kayak by flipping it over.
sentences.zh: 排水塞在平时是旋紧的，只有在岸上时才会将其取下，通过把皮划艇翻转过来，排出积在里面的水。

sentences.en: When Vincent's kayak was recovered, the plug was notably missing.
sentences.zh: 当文森特的皮划艇被寻获时，引人注目的是那个塞子不见了。

sentences.en: Without it, the kayak had an open hole about the size of a nickel on top.
sentences.zh: 没有了它，皮划艇顶部就会有一个大约硬币大小的开口。

sentences.en: While this wouldn't have been a problem during the karma paddle to Bannerman's Island, the worsening conditions on the return trip could have splashed water into the hole,
sentences.zh: 虽然在平静地划向班纳曼岛期间这不会成问题，但在返程时不断恶化的天气可能会让水溅进这个洞里，

sentences.en: theoretically sinking the kayak.
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲，这会导致皮划艇沉没。

sentences.en: Detective De Quarto asked Angelica, Is that why Vincent's kayak sank?
sentences.zh: 德夸托侦查员问安杰利卡：“这就是文森特的皮划艇沉没的原因吗？”

sentences.en: Yes, she replied.
sentences.zh: “是的，”她回答道。

sentences.en: De Quarto then asked if Angelica had taken the plug out.
sentences.zh: 德夸托接着问安杰利卡是不是她把塞子拔掉的。

sentences.en: Yes, I think I did, she answered.
sentences.zh: “是的，我想是我，”她回答说。

sentences.en: But that wasn't all
sentences.zh: 但这还不是全部。

sentences.en: Vincent used a two-piece paddle which was designed to be taken apart for easier transportation and storage
sentences.zh: 文森特使用的是一副两段式的双头桨，这种设计可以拆卸，方便携带和存放

sentences.en: The rods of the two halves were clipped together and tightened in place with two safety rings ensuring they stayed securely connected during use
sentences.zh: 这两半桨的杆子通过卡扣连接，并用两个安全环拧紧固定，确保它们在使用的过程中保持稳固

sentences.en: Angelica told Detective De Quarto that she had removed one of the safety rings from Vincent's paddle making it less stable and difficult to use effectively.
sentences.zh: 安杰丽卡告诉德夸托警探，她把文森特桨上的一个安全环取了下来，这使得桨的稳定性变差，很难有效地使用。

sentences.en: Once again, this was news to Detective De Quarto.
sentences.zh: 对德夸托警探来说，这也是个新消息。

sentences.en: Angelica had managed to recover Vincent's paddle during their ordeal and had clipped it to her own kayak.
sentences.zh: 在经历了一番艰难处境后，安杰丽卡设法找回了文森特的桨，并把它夹在自己的皮划艇上。

sentences.en: When her kayak was retrieved from the river, investigators hadn't been aware of the safety rings and therefore hadn't noticed if one was missing from Vincent's paddle at the time.
sentences.zh: 当她的皮划艇从河里打捞上来时，调查人员当时并不知道安全环的事，因此也没有注意到文森特的桨上少了一个安全环。

sentences.en: Detective De Quarto asked Angelica,
sentences.zh: 德夸托警探问安杰丽卡：

sentences.en: Did you take the plug out and remove the ring from the paddle because you wanted Vincent dead?
sentences.zh: 你拔掉塞子并从桨上取下环，是因为你想让文森特死吗？

sentences.en: She responded bluntly,
sentences.zh: 她直言不讳地回答：

sentences.en: Yes, I guess I did.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是的。

sentences.en: De Quarto continued,
sentences.zh: 德夸托接着问：

sentences.en: Was there a point you could have helped Vincent or saved him, but you didn't?
sentences.zh: 有没有那么一个时刻，你本可以帮助文森特或者救他，但你却没有这么做？

sentences.en: Yes, she answered.
sentences.zh: 是的，她回答说。

sentences.en: Angelica divulged that Vincent had been clinging to his paddle in the water to help keep himself afloat and she had taken it away from him
sentences.zh: 安杰丽卡透露，文森特当时在水中紧紧抓住他的桨来保持浮力，而她却把它从他手里拿走了

sentences.en: So you didn't help him, De Quarto clarified
sentences.zh: 所以你没有帮他，德夸托明确问道

sentences.en: No, Angelica confirmed I wanted him gone I wanted to be free I wanted to be myself
sentences.zh: 没有，安杰丽卡证实道，我希望他消失，我想要自由，我想要做自己

sentences.en: When Detective De Quarto recounted Angelica's confession to his team on Bannerman's Island, they were shocked.
sentences.zh: 当德夸托警探向班纳曼岛上的团队复述安杰丽卡的供词时，大家都震惊了。

sentences.en: Unprepared for this turn of events, they hadn't bought any recording devices or pens and paper to document her statement.
sentences.zh: 由于对这记突如其来的变故毫无准备，他们没有带任何录音设备或纸笔来记录她的陈述。

sentences.en: Regardless, their investigation promptly shifted to a murder inquiry.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他们的调查迅速转为谋杀案侦查。

sentences.en: Angelica willingly got on a police boat to be taken to the New York State police barracks for a formal interview
sentences.zh: 安杰丽卡自愿坐上警船，被带往纽约州立警察局接受正式讯问

sentences.en: It seemed she didn't fully grasp the gravity of the situation
sentences.zh: 看起来她并没有完全意识到局势的严重性

sentences.en: During the boat trip, Angelica appeared completely unbothered, enjoying the wind, smiling, and even whistling
sentences.zh: 在乘船的过程中，安杰丽卡显得若无其事，享受着微风，面带微笑，甚至还吹着口哨

sentences.en: The detectives exchanged puzzled looks when she suddenly threw up her hands and announced
sentences.zh: 当她突然双手一摊并宣布时，警探们面面相觑，感到不解

sentences.en: I'm free.
sentences.zh: 我自由了。

sentences.en: Angelica's carefree attitude remained when she arrived at the police barracks at around
sentences.zh: 大约在下午

sentences.en: 3.30pm, casually telling Detective De Quarto,
sentences.zh: 3点30分抵达警察局时，安杰丽卡那种无忧无虑的态度依旧没有改变，她随口对德夸托警探说：

sentences.en: When I first saw you, I thought you were cute.
sentences.zh: 我第一次见到你的时候，觉得你挺可爱的。

sentences.en: Unsure of how to respond to the inappropriate remark, De Quarto simply said, thank you.
sentences.zh: 德夸托不知该如何回应这句不得体的话，只好说：谢谢。

sentences.en: He then proceeded to read Angelica her Miranda rights, which she said she understood.
sentences.zh: 接着他开始向安杰丽卡宣读米兰达警告，她表示自己听懂了。

sentences.en: Given that Detective De Quarto had no proof of Angelica's earlier confession on Bannerman's Island, he initiated the formal interview hoping she would
sentences.zh: 鉴于德夸托警探没有安杰丽卡此前在班纳曼岛上供认的证据，他启动了正式讯问，希望她能

sentences.en: repeat her claims while being recorded.
sentences.zh: 在被录音的情况下重复她的话。

sentences.en: So, we had a good discussion up there, De Quarto began.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们在那上面聊得很开心，德夸托开口道。

sentences.en: We did, Angelica agreed.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，安杰丽卡附和道。

sentences.en: I think you feel a lot better.
sentences.zh: 我想你现在感觉好多了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I do, thanks, Angelica confirmed.
sentences.zh: 是的，我好了，谢谢，安杰丽卡证实道，

sentences.en: rubbing her hands together.
sentences.zh: 同时双手互相揉搓着。

sentences.en: De Quarto continued.
sentences.zh: 德夸托继续说道。

sentences.en: I know you probably don't want to run through it again, but this is what we have to do.
sentences.zh: 我知道你可能不想再经历一遍，但这是我们必须要做的事。

sentences.en: I understand, Angelica replied.
sentences.zh: 我理解，安杰丽卡回答。

sentences.en: It's therapy for you,
sentences.zh: 这对你来说是一场治疗，

sentences.en: De Quarto assured Angelica.
sentences.zh: 德夸托向安杰丽卡保证道。

sentences.en: You'll feel better.
sentences.zh: 你会感觉好些的。

sentences.en: At ease, Angelica opened up about her relationship with Vincent.
sentences.zh: 放松下来后，安杰丽卡敞开心扉，谈起了她与文森特的关系。

sentences.en: She confessed that she felt trapped because he made frequent sexual demands that left her feeling uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 她坦言自己感到被困住，因为对方频繁提出让她感到不适的性要求。

sentences.en: She said Vincent wanted to have threesomes, watch pornography together, engage in a dominant submissive dynamic, and have Angelica pose for racy photographs.
sentences.zh: 她说文森特想要搞3P、一起看色情片、玩SM主奴游戏，还让安杰丽卡摆出挑逗的姿势拍大尺度照片。

sentences.en: If she refused to entertain his requests, he would postpone their wedding or threaten to call it off entirely.

sentences.zh: 安杰丽卡声称，当他们前往班纳曼岛时，文森特知道他的皮划艇上没有塞子，而且他并不介意缺少这个塞子。

sentences.zh: 她坚称自己拔掉塞子绝无害人之意，并强调：我没想过要杀文森特或者诸如此类的事。

sentences.zh: 讯问一直持续到深夜，期间穿插了数次休息。

sentences.zh: 在这些间隙中，安杰丽卡似乎表现得极其冷漠，对自己的困境毫不在意。

sentences.zh: 随着时间一小时小时过去，安杰丽卡开始说一些古怪的话。

sentences.zh: 经过11个小时的高强度盘问，

sentences.en: Angelica Gruswold had admitted to removing the drain plug from Vincent Villafor's kayak and wanting him to die,
sentences.zh: 安杰丽卡·格鲁斯沃尔德已经承认自己拔掉了文森特·维拉福尔皮划艇上的排水塞，并且希望他去死，
zh_words: 安杰丽卡·格鲁斯沃尔德

sentences.en: but she'd stopped short of making an outright confession to his murder.
sentences.zh: 但她始终没有承认自己蓄意谋杀了他。

sentences.en: Even though Vincent's body was still missing, investigators felt satisfied that Angelica had intentionally caused his death.
sentences.zh: 尽管文森特的尸体仍未找到，但调查人员认为安杰丽卡蓄意导致了他的死亡，对此深信不疑。

sentences.en: They charged her with second-degree murder as well as second-degree manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 他们以二级谋杀罪和二级过失杀人罪对她提起指控。

sentences.en: If found guilty, she faced a possible 25 years to life in prison.
sentences.zh: 如果罪名成立，她将面临25年至终身监禁的刑罚。

sentences.en: The charges sparked mixed reactions among those who knew Angelica and Vincent.
sentences.zh: 这些指控在认识安杰丽卡和文森特的人群中引发了复杂的反应。

sentences.en: Some believed there was no way Angelica could have caused Vincent any harm, with one friend remarking, Vincent always had his arm around her, they were lovey-dovey.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为安杰丽卡绝不可能伤害文森特，一位朋友评论说：文森特总是搂着她，他们俩非常恩爱。

sentences.en: I always like to give people the benefit of the doubt.
sentences.zh: 我总是愿意把人往好的方面想。

sentences.zh: 我想文森特也会希望大家把安杰丽卡往好的方面想。

sentences.en: Most people knew Angelica to be kind-hearted, bright and mild-mannered, not a cold-blooded killer.
sentences.zh: 在大多数人眼中，安杰丽卡是个心地善良、开朗温和的人，绝不是什么冷血杀手。

sentences.en: The couple's neighbours had never even heard them argue.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇的邻居甚至从未听过他们吵架。

sentences.en: However, an ex-boyfriend of Angelica's painted a very different picture.
sentences.zh: 然而，安杰丽卡的前男友却描绘了一幅截然不同的画面。

sentences.en: He claimed that Angelica had a violent streak when she didn't get her way, describing her behaviour as a way of reacting when she feels threatened.
sentences.zh: 他声称安杰丽卡在事不如愿时有着暴躁的一面，并把这种行为形容为她感到受到威胁时的反应。

sentences.en: When they broke up, he said Angelica lay behind his car to prevent him from leaving with their pet cat, even though she didn't have a place to house it.
sentences.zh: 他说，当他们分手时，安杰丽卡趴在他的车后，阻止他带着他们的宠物猫离开，尽管她自己并没有地方安置这只猫。

sentences.en: She threatened to break into the house to retrieve the cat until he relented and handed it over.
sentences.zh: 她威胁说要破门而入把猫抢回来，直到他妥协并把猫交了出去。

sentences.en: After separating from her second husband, Angelica reportedly took many of his belongings, only returning them after a court order forced her to do so.
sentences.zh: 据报道，在与第二任丈夫分居后，安杰丽卡拿走了他许多物品，直到法院下达命令强制要求，她才将其归还。

sentences.en: Although Vincent's mother Mary Ann was shocked to learn about the charges against Angelica, it explained her callous behaviour in the aftermath of Vincent's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 尽管文森特的母亲玛丽·安恩得知对安杰丽卡的指控时感到震惊，但这解释了她在文森特失踪后表现出的冷酷无情。

sentences.en: Mary Ann told the TV show 48 Hours,
sentences.zh: 玛丽·安对电视节目《48小时》说，

sentences.en: I do not believe that this was an accident.
sentences.zh: 我不相信这是一场意外。

sentences.en: I was devastated that Angelica would do that to my son, who was so good to her.
sentences.zh: 安杰利卡竟然对对我儿子做出这种事，我感到痛彻心扉，我儿子对她那么好。

sentences.en: Many Hudson River locals thought the case was suspicious from the start, with one telling the Washington Post,
sentences.zh: 许多哈德逊河当地人从一开始就觉得这个案子很可疑，其中一人告诉《华盛顿邮报》：

sentences.en: It didn't add up.
sentences.zh: 这根本说不通。

sentences.en: From day one, I thought it had to be a murder myself.
sentences.zh: 从第一天起，我自己就觉得这一定是一起谋杀。

sentences.en: I really did.
sentences.zh: 我真的是这么想的。

sentences.en: The bizarre case became a media sensation, with Angelica Graswold dubbed the Kayak Killer.
sentences.zh: 这起离奇的案件轰动了整个媒体，安杰利卡·格拉斯沃尔德被称为“皮划艇杀手”。
zh_words: 安杰利卡·格拉斯沃尔德

sentences.en: The apparent financial motive for the killing, combined with scandalous rumours about the couple's sex life, fuelled dramatic and provocative headlines.
sentences.zh: 这起谋杀案表面上的金钱动机，加上关于这对夫妇性生活的香艳传闻，引发了戏剧性且煽动性的头条新闻。

sentences.en: Angelica's innocent, youthful looks and gentle nature contrasted sharply with the unapologetically insensitive
sentences.zh: 安杰利卡天真、年轻的面容和温和的性格，与她那种毫不掩饰的麻木不仁形成了鲜明的对比。

sentences.en: way she spoke about Vincent, turning her into a highly contentious figure.
sentences.zh: 她谈论文森特的方式，使她成了一个极具争议的人物。

sentences.en: Her behaviour continued to mystify those around her, with a prison officer noting that despite her predicament, she often appeared almost cheerful.
sentences.zh: 她的行为让身边的人感到迷惑不解，一名狱警指出，尽管身处困境，她看起来却常常近乎高兴。

sentences.en: In the court of public opinion,
sentences.zh: 在公众舆论的法庭上，

sentences.en: Vincent was seen as a likeable everyman, while Angelica was painted as a manipulative and calculating foreign vixen.

sentences.en: They also tested the use of a paddle without a safety ring and confirmed that it would have been extremely difficult to paddle without it, even in calm waters.

sentences.en: The friend texted Angelica to let her know that they could see her and Angelica waved back.

sentences.en: As Portale pointed out, if Angelica had truly confessed, why didn't the police arrest her immediately?

sentences.en: Over the 11-hour interview, Angelica still couldn't replicate her supposed confession, even after repeated prompting.
sentences.zh: 在长达11小时的讯问中，尽管屡次受到启发，安杰利卡仍然无法复述出她所谓的供词。

sentences.en: Richard Portale also argued that the integrity of Angelica's police interview was flawed due to a significant language barrier.
sentences.zh: 理查德·波塔莱还辩称，由于存在严重的语言障碍，安杰利卡警讯的完整性受到了损害。

sentences.en: Given that English was not Angelica's first language, she was led to believe she was communicating effectively when, in fact, she wasn't.
sentences.zh: 鉴于英语不是安杰利卡的母语，她被误导以为自己沟通得很有效，而事实上并非如此。

sentences.en: Portale said that Angelica wanted to appear confident, so she often responded affirmatively to questions even when she didn't fully understand them.
sentences.zh: 波塔莱说，安杰利卡希望显得自信，所以即使她并不完全理解问题，也经常对问题做出肯定的回答。

sentences.en: About seven hours into the interview, she asked what Miranda rights were, indicating that she hadn't fully understood them when they were initially read to her.
sentences.zh: 在大约讯问进行了七个小时后，她询问什么是米兰达权利，这表明她在最初被宣读这些权利时并没有完全理解。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Angelica entered the interview unaware that she was a suspect.
sentences.zh: 此外，安杰利卡进入讯问室时并不知道自己是一名嫌疑人。

sentences.en: As a result, she didn't request legal counsel beforehand.
sentences.zh: 因此，她事先没有要求法律顾问。

sentences.en: Having grown up around police with a father who was an officer in Latvia, she inherently trusted law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 由于在警察身边的环境中长大，其父亲是拉脱维亚的一名警官，她对执法人员有着天然的信任。

sentences.en: She later admitted to Well magazine, that was my fault.

sentences.zh: 在讯问开始时，侦探告诉安杰利卡这个过程是心理治疗，并且他们不断向她保证诚实会带来宽大处理且不会被评判。

sentences.en: This encouraged her to speak openly about her conflicting feelings toward Vincent, unaware that her words could be used against her.
sentences.zh: 这鼓励她公开谈论她对文森特矛盾的情感，却没有意识到她的话会被用来对付她。

sentences.en: Had this little known fact been more widely understood, she believed it might have shifted public perception of her
sentences.zh: 如果这个鲜为人知的事实被更广泛地理解，她相信这可能会改变公众对她的看法

sentences.en: One of the key elements of the prosecution's case against Angelica was the missing drain plug, which they claimed Angelica removed to intentionally sink Vincent's kayak.
sentences.zh: 针对安杰利卡案控方证据的关键要素之一是丢失的排水塞，他们声称安杰利卡移除了它以故意沉没文森特的皮划艇。

sentences.en: But Richard Portale pointed out that Vincent often kayaked without the plug in order to secure the kayak to his car.
sentences.zh: 但理查德·波塔莱指出，文森特经常在没有塞子的情按下划皮划艇，以便将皮划艇固定在汽车上。

sentences.en: Surveillance footage from traffic cameras on the afternoon that Vincent and Angelica drove to Plum Point Park showed Vincent's kayak strapped to the roof
sentences.zh: 文森特和安杰利卡开车去普姆角公园那天下午的交通摄像头监控录像显示，文森特的皮划艇绑在车顶上

sentences.en: of his car through the drain plug hole.
sentences.zh: 通过排水塞孔穿过他的汽车。

sentences.en: Portale argued that the missing drain plug was a red herring and it hadn't even contributed to Vincent's death.
sentences.zh: 波塔莱辩称，丢失的排水塞是一个干扰视听的红鲱鱼，它甚至没有导致文森特的死。

sentences.en: He explained,
sentences.zh: 他解释说，

sentences.en: When waves hit the kayak, they crash into the cockpit, not the drain plug hole.
sentences.zh: 当海浪拍打皮划艇时，它们撞击的是驾驶舱，而不是排水塞孔。

sentences.en: Water wouldn't enter it significantly enough to submerge the kayak.
sentences.zh: 水不会大量进入以致淹没皮划艇。

sentences.en: To test the theory, ABC's 2020 program, Mystery on the Hudson, as well as 48 hours program, Death on the Hudson, both carried out their own recreations.
sentences.zh: 为了检验这一理论，ABC的2020年节目《哈德逊河上的谜团》以及48小时节目《哈德逊河上的死亡》都进行了各自的重现。

sentences.en: In both programs, experts found that even in choppy waters, only a small amount of water entered the kayak through the drain plug hole, nowhere near enough to sink the vessel.
sentences.zh: 在这两个节目中，专家发现，即使在波涛汹涌的水面上，也只有少量的水通过排水塞孔进入皮划艇，远远不足以沉没船只。

sentences.en: The majority of the water entered through the cockpit, just like Angelica claimed had happened to Vincent.
sentences.zh: 大部分水都是通过驾驶舱进入的，就像安杰利卡声称发生在文森特身上的那样。

sentences.en: 48 hours also conducted a test where the cockpit was completely sealed, leaving only the drain plug hole open.
sentences.zh: 《48小时》还进行了一项测试，其中驾驶舱被完全密封，只留下排水塞孔打开。

sentences.en: In this scenario, less than an ounce of water, not even the size of a shot glass, entered the kayak.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，不到一盎司的水（甚至连一个烈酒杯的大小都没有）进入了皮划艇。

sentences.en: Tests were also done to see how effectively a person could kayak using a paddle that was missing one of its safety rings
sentences.zh: 还进行了测试，以了解一个人在使用少了一个安全环的船桨时划皮划艇的有效性

sentences.en: It turned out to be no trouble at all
sentences.zh: 事实证明一点问题也没有

sentences.en: The prosecution also claimed that Angelica had taken the paddle from Vincent so he couldn't use it to keep himself afloat
sentences.zh: 控方还声称安杰利卡拿走了文森特的船桨，这样他就不能用它来维持自己浮在水面上

sentences.en: Testing conducted by 48 Hours concluded that a paddle alone wasn't enough to keep a fully grown man afloat anyway
sentences.zh: 《48小时》进行的测试得出的结论是，无论如何，仅靠一把船桨不足以让一个成年男子浮在水面上

sentences.en: In all the testing conducted by various media outlets and news programs, none were able to replicate the results claimed by the case investigators.
sentences.zh: 在各家媒体和新闻节目进行的所有测试中，没有一个能够复制案件调查人员声称的结果。

sentences.en: Angelica agreed to an interview for the 2020 segment.
sentences.zh: 安杰利卡同意接受2020年栏目的采访。

sentences.en: When asked why she chose to speak publicly, she stated, I just needed a chance to let people know I'm innocent.
sentences.zh: 当被问及为什么选择公开讲话时，她表示，我只是需要一个机会让人们知道我是清白的。

sentences.en: I'm being accused of murder, which I'm not capable of doing.
sentences.zh: 我被指控谋杀，这是我做不出来的。

sentences.en: She explained that her comments about wanting to be free of
sentences.zh: 她解释说，她关于想要摆脱

sentences.en: Vincent related to the lifestyle they were living, not Vincent himself.
sentences.zh: 文森特的言论与他们当时过的生活方式有关，而不是文森特本人。

sentences.en: In another interview with
sentences.zh: 在接受

sentences.en: News 12, Angelica said that her incriminating diary entries about wanting Vincent dead were outdated and written in anger during a difficult time.
sentences.zh: News 12的另一次采访中，安杰利卡说，她关于想要文森特死的那些 incriminating（自我定罪的）日记条目已经过时，是在困难时期生气时写的。

sentences.en: I didn't really mean it, she said.
sentences.zh: 我不是真的那个意思，她说。

sentences.en: I was very much in love with Vincent and would never have hurt him.
sentences.zh: 我深爱着文森特，绝不可能伤害他。

sentences.en: Richard Portale dismissed the alleged motive of Vincent's life insurance policy, arguing it didn't align with Angelica's character, saying, she's not someone who cares about money.
sentences.zh: 理查德·波塔莱驳回了关于文森特人寿保险单的谋杀动机指控，辩称这与安杰丽卡的性格不符，并表示她并不是一个在乎金钱的人。

sentences.en: She's a simple girl from a simple country more interested in flowers, photographs and sunsets than in financial gain.
sentences.zh: 她只是一个来自质朴乡村的单纯女孩，相比于经济利益，她对花朵、摄影和日落更感兴趣。

sentences.en: Portale asserted that
sentences.zh: 波塔莱断言，

sentences.en: Vincent's death was an accident caused by a combination of factors, including his own failure to respect the dangers of the water.
sentences.zh: 文森特的死是一场意外，是由多种因素共同导致的，其中包括他本人未能重视水域的危险。

sentences.en: After all, Vincent had entered the tumultuous river after drinking a few beers, without a life jacket, wetsuit, spray skirt or drain plug.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，文森特是在喝了几杯啤酒后进入波涛汹涌的河中的，当时没有穿救生衣、潜水衣、防水裙，也没有安装排水塞。

sentences.en: In Portale's opinion, the idea that Angelica had meticulously planned the killing was absurd.
sentences.zh: 在波塔莱看来，安杰丽卡处心积虑策划谋杀的说法是荒谬的。

sentences.en: She had no control over the weather, the river conditions, or Vincent's decisions and actions that day.
sentences.zh: 她无法控制那天的主办天气、河流状况，也无法控制文森特的决定和行动。

sentences.en: Referring to Vincent as the captain of his own ship, Portale told 2020,
sentences.zh: 波塔莱在接受《20/20》节目采访时，将文森特比作他自己船只的船长，并说道：

sentences.en: I'm not here to blame Mr. Viafor for his own death, but Ms. Graswold is not his mother.
sentences.zh: 我来这里不是为了指责维亚福尔先生自己的死，但格拉斯沃德女士不是他的母亲。

sentences.en: He's a grown man, and that's really his responsibility.
sentences.zh: 他是一个成年人，这确实是他的责任。

sentences.en: On Saturday, May 23, 2015, 34 days after Vincent Villafor's disappearance, a recreational boater spotted Vincent's body floating face down in the Hudson River,
sentences.zh: 2015年5月23日星期六，即文森特·维亚福尔失踪34天后，一名消遣泛舟者发现文森特的尸体面朝下漂浮在哈德逊河上，

sentences.en: about a mile downstream from Bannerman's Island.
sentences.zh: 大约在班纳曼岛下游一英里处。

sentences.en: He hadn't drifted far from where his kayak had capsized.
sentences.zh: 他的漂流距离皮划艇倾覆的地方并不远。

sentences.en: The discovery brought bittersweet relief to Vincent's loved ones I was both sad and happy, his mother Mary Ann told 48 hours
sentences.zh: 这一发现给文森特的亲人带来了一种苦乐参半的宽慰。他的母亲玛丽·安恩在接受《48小时》采访时表示：“我既伤心又高兴。”

sentences.en: Sad that there was no hope And happy that at least we found him and could bring him home
sentences.zh: 伤心的是已经毫无希望，高兴的是至少我们找到了他，并能带他回家。

sentences.en: As Vincent's body underwent an autopsy
sentences.zh: 随着文森特的尸体接受尸检，

sentences.en: Richard Portale expressed confidence that the findings wouldn't harm Angelica's case
sentences.zh: 理查德·波塔莱表达了他的信心，认为调查结果不会损害安杰丽卡的案情，

sentences.en: He expected the cause of Vincent's death would be classified as accidental drowning or hypothermia with alcohol as a factor,
sentences.zh: 他预计文森特的死因将被归类为意外溺水或低体温症，其中酒精是一个诱因，

sentences.en: which would lead to the charges against Angelica being dropped.
sentences.zh: 这将导致针对安杰丽卡的指控被撤销。

sentences.en: The autopsy confirmed Vincent's cause of death as drowning, with a blood alcohol concentration of 0.06, indicating early stage intoxication.
sentences.zh: 尸检证实文森特的死因是溺水，其血液酒精浓度为0.06，表明处于初级阶段的酒精中毒状态。

sentences.en: intoxication.
sentences.zh: 酒精中毒。

sentences.en: However, the medical examiner ultimately ruled Vincent's death a homicide, stating it was caused by a kayak drain plug intentionally removed by another.
sentences.zh: 然而，法医最终将文森特的死判定为凶杀，称其是由他人蓄意拔掉皮划艇排水塞所致。

sentences.en: The result left many stunned.
sentences.zh: 这一结果让许多人震惊。

sentences.en: For those who believed Vincent's death was an accident, the autopsy failed to provide crucial evidence of foul play.
sentences.zh: 对于那些相信文森特之死是意外的人来说，尸检未能提供存在谋杀行为的关键证据。

sentences.en: Richard Portale argued that the findings were based on statements from New York State Police and didn't reflect the test's expert opinions or evidence at hand.
sentences.zh: 理查德·波塔莱辩称，这些调查结果是基于纽约州警察的陈述，并未反映测试专家的意见或手头的证据。

sentences.en: He questioned how the medical examiner could have used the word intentionally in connection with the missing drain plug.
sentences.zh: 他质疑法医怎么会在提到失踪的排水塞时使用“蓄意”这个词。

sentences.en: Did she find that under a microscope, he asked, before adding.
sentences.zh: 他问道：“她是通过显微镜发现这一点的吗？”随后又补充道。

sentences.en: In New York, a medical examiner properly relies on medical evidence.
sentences.zh: 在纽约，法医合理地依赖医学证据。

sentences.en: They can consider other factors, but the issue of intent is for the jury to decide.
sentences.zh: 他们可以考虑其他因素，但意图问题应由陪审团决定。

sentences.en: While the autopsy's findings strengthened the prosecution's case for murder, Angelica's legal team prepared their false confession defence.
sentences.zh: 虽然尸检结果增强了控方关于谋杀的指控，但安杰丽卡的法律团队准备了虚假供述辩护。

sentences.en: Then, just weeks before her trial, Angelica made a stunning decision.
sentences.zh: 随后，就在审判前几周，安杰丽卡做出了一项令人震惊的决定。

sentences.en: She tearfully pleaded guilty to a lesser felony charge of criminally negligent homicide.
sentences.zh: 她含泪对较轻的刑事疏忽过失杀人罪名表示认罪。

sentences.en: As part of the plea deal, she admitted to engaging in blameworthy conduct so serious that it contributed to a substantial and unjustifiable risk of Vincent's death.
sentences.zh: 作为认罪协议的一部分，她承认实施了应受谴责的行为，且该行为严重到导致了文森特死亡的重大且不合理的风险。

sentences.en: This included removing the drain plug from Vincent's kayak, knowing the safety ring was missing from his paddle, and being aware of the hazardous weather conditions.
sentences.zh: 这包括从文森特的皮划艇上拔下排水塞，明知他的船桨缺少安全环，并且清楚危险的天气状况。

sentences.en: She also knew that Vincent wasn't wearing a life vest or wetsuit, had been drinking and that the cold, treacherous waters of the Hudson River posed a significant danger.
sentences.zh: 她还知道文森特没有穿救生衣或潜水衣，喝过酒，而且哈德逊河冰冷、险恶的水域构成了重大危险。

sentences.en: Angelica conceded that, with this knowledge, she should have acted differently to prevent harm and save Vincent's life.
sentences.zh: 安杰丽卡承认，在拥有这些认知的情况下，她本应采取不同的行动来防止伤害并拯救文森特的生命。

sentences.en: Explaining how they reached the plea deal, the district attorney said that proving intentional murder would have been challenging in court, given the lack of
sentences.zh: 在解释他们是如何达成认罪协议时，地方检察官表示，鉴于缺乏

sentences.en: eyewitnesses and limited physical evidence.
sentences.zh: 目击者和有限的物证，在法庭上证明蓄意谋杀将非常困难。

sentences.en: The case relied heavily on Angelica's alleged confession on Bannerman's Island and her 11-hour recorded interview, but none of her vacillating
sentences.zh: 此案在很大程度上依赖于安杰丽卡在班纳曼岛上的所谓供述以及她那长达11小时的录像采访，但她那些摇摆不定的

sentences.en: statements constituted a direct confession for intentional murder.
sentences.zh: 言论并未构成蓄意谋杀的直接供述。

sentences.en: Due to the significant amount of time that had passed since her arrest, the opportunity to have Angelica evaluated by the
sentences.zh: 由于自她被捕以来已经过去了很长时间，让安杰丽卡接受

sentences.en: prosecution's psychiatric experts, who could have potentially countered claims that she had made a false confession, was no longer feasible.
sentences.zh: 控方精神病学专家的评估的机会——这本可以用来反驳她曾做出虚假供述的主张——已经不再可行。

sentences.en: The plea deal ultimately removed the uncertainty of a lengthy trial in which Angelica could escape conviction and spared Vincent's family from further emotional distress.
sentences.zh: 认罪协议最终消除了漫长审判的不确定性，在审判中安杰丽卡可能会逃脱定罪，并使文森特的家人免受进一步的情感痛苦。

sentences.en: At Angelica's sentencing, the judge made it clear the court didn't accept her version of events and believed she acted maliciously.
sentences.zh: 在对安杰丽卡进行宣判时，法官明确表示法院不接受她对事件经过的说法，并认为她行为恶劣。

sentences.en: You could have walked out on Vincent if you were unhappy, instead of whatever it was in your mind that led to removing the plug and taking other actions.
sentences.zh: 如果你不高兴，你本可以离开文森特，而不是出于你脑海中不知是什么的想法去拔掉塞子并采取其他行动。

sentences.en: The judge emphasised that it was ultimately
sentences.zh: 法官强调，最终正是

sentences.en: Angelica's failure to assist Vincent when he was struggling in the water that led to his death.
sentences.zh: 安杰丽卡在文森特在水中挣扎时未能施以援手，才导致了他的死亡。

sentences.en: You certainly have a lack of understanding of other people's feelings, he said
sentences.zh: 他说：“你确实缺乏对他人感受的理解。”

sentences.en: Noting Angelica's excessive need for admiration and pointing to her exaggerated feelings of self-worth
sentences.zh: 在注意到安杰丽卡对赞美的过度需求并指出她夸大的自我价值感后，

sentences.en: He characterised Vincent as an unnecessary victim of Angelica's mindset
sentences.zh: 他将文森特描述为安杰丽卡心态下的一个不必要的受害者，

sentences.en: Suggesting that her failure to help him was driven by her own self-centred motivations
sentences.zh: 暗示她未能施救是出于她自己以自我为中心的动机。

sentences.en: Angelica Graswold was sentenced to 16 to 48 months in prison, the maximum for criminally negligent homicide.
sentences.zh: 安杰丽卡·格拉斯沃德被判处16至48个月监禁，这是对刑事疏忽过失杀人罪的最高刑罚。

sentences.en: The outcome was criticised in the media, with many viewing the kayak killer as receiving
sentences.zh: 这一结果在媒体上受到了批评，许多人认为这位“皮划艇杀手”受到的惩罚

sentences.en: little more than a slap on the wriSt. Vincent's mother Mary Ann was equally dissatisfied, stating
sentences.zh: 不过是轻描淡写。文森特的母亲玛丽·安恩同样感到不满，她表示：

sentences.en: Four years for taking someone's life?
sentences.zh: 夺走别人的生命只需四年？

sentences.en: No way.
sentences.zh: 绝不可能。

sentences.en: My son was a good man and everyone loved him.
sentences.zh: 我的儿子是个好人，所有人都爱他。

sentences.en: In a statement read by her legal counsel outside the courthouse, Angelica said I loved Vince very much and miss him terribly.
sentences.zh: 安杰丽卡在法院外由其法律顾问宣读的一份声明中说：“我非常爱文斯，也无比想念他。”

sentences.en: I don't believe I was treated fairly.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我受到了公平对待。

sentences.en: The entire process was one-sided and unjuSt.
sentences.zh: 整个过程都是单方面的，极不公正。

sentences.en: I've learned you're not innocent until proven guilty.
sentences.zh: 我明白了，在被证明有罪之前，你并不是无辜的。

sentences.en: I'm not a murderer.
sentences.zh: 我不是一个谋杀犯。

sentences.en: I've said that from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 我从一开始就这么说。

sentences.en: If I could bring Vince back, I would.
sentences.zh: 如果我能把文斯带回来，我愿意这么做。

sentences.en: With time served, Angelica was released on parole in December 2017 after spending 32 months in prison.
sentences.zh: 在服刑期满后，安杰丽卡在监狱服刑32个月后于2017年12月获得假释出狱。

sentences.en: In an interview with 2020, she explained that she took the plea deal to avoid a life sentence for a crime she didn't commit.
sentences.zh: 在接受《20/20》采访时，她解释说她之所以接受认罪协议，是为了避免因一项她并未犯下的罪行而被判处无期徒刑。

sentences.en: Despite her plea, Angelica said she didn't feel guilty.
sentences.zh: 尽管已经认罪，安杰丽卡表示她并不感到内疚。

sentences.en: I have to let it go, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说：“我必须放下它。”

sentences.en: I can't live with that all the time.
sentences.zh: 我无法时时刻刻背负着这个生活。

sentences.en: They can say whatever they want.
sentences.zh: 他们想说什么就说什么。

sentences.en: I know the truth, and God knows the truth.
sentences.zh: 我知道真相，上帝也知道真相。

sentences.en: Angelica intended to use Vincent's life insurance payout to pay for her legal fees, but Vincent's family filed a wrongful death lawsuit against her
sentences.zh: 安杰丽卡原本打算用文森特的人寿保险赔偿金来支付她的律师费，但文森特的家人对她提起了过失致死民事诉讼，

sentences.en: to prevent her from collecting the money.
sentences.zh: 以阻止她领取这笔钱。

sentences.en: The case was settled confidentially.
sentences.zh: 该案件最终以保密方式达成庭外和解。

sentences.en: Vincent's family maintained their belief that Angelica was responsible for his death, with his mother Marianne vowing never to see her again.
sentences.zh: 文森特的家人坚信安杰丽卡应对他的死负责，他的母亲玛丽安发誓再也不见她。

sentences.en: Vincent's sister said,
sentences.zh: 文森特的妹妹说：

sentences.en: Although Vincent's family felt that justice hadn't been served, they vowed to keep Vincent's spirit alive by living their lives with the same boundless joy that he did.
sentences.zh: 尽管文森特的家人觉得正义并未得到伸张，但他们发誓要像文森特生前那样带着无限的喜悦生活下去，以此让文森特的精神永存。

sentences.en: Vincent's sister said,
sentences.zh: 文森特的妹妹说：

sentences.en: The world has lost a truly amazing person and we can never get him back.
sentences.zh: 世界失去了一个真正了不起的人，我们再也找不回他了。

sentences.en: While public opinion remains divided over whether Vincent's death was an accident or intentional,
sentences.zh: 尽管公众对文森特的死是意外还是蓄意仍存在分歧，

sentences.en: Angelica told Elle magazine that through her growing faith, she no longer cares what others think.
sentences.zh: 安杰丽卡对《Elle》杂志表示，通过不断增长的信仰，她不再在乎别人的看法。

sentences.en: Bottom line, I'm the only living person who's still here, and I'm the only one who knows, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说：“归根结底，我是唯一还活在世上的人，也是唯一知情的人。”

sentences.en: Vincent loved me, I loved him.
sentences.zh: 文森特爱我，我也爱他。

sentences.en: He had said he would die for me if need be, and I feel like he did, so I could live.
sentences.zh: 他曾说如果有必要他会为我而死，我觉得他确实做到了，所以我才能活下来。

sentences.en: He saved me, in a way.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，他救了我。

sentences.en: Angelica explained that although she was willing to drown to save Vincent, it was he who urged her to call 911.
sentences.zh: 安杰丽卡解释说，尽管她愿意为了拯救文森特而溺水，但正是文森特催促她拨打911。

sentences.en: The dispatcher had then instructed Angelica to paddle toward the shore where an emergency vehicle had just arrived instead of continuing her efforts to rescue Vincent and risk her
sentences.zh: 调度员随后指示安杰丽卡划向岸边——一辆紧急救援车辆刚刚抵达那里，而不是继续她对文森特的救援并拿她自己的

sentences.en: own life.
sentences.zh: 生命去冒险。

sentences.en: I've been in these situations on the Hudson before where it was dangerous and I always got out of it, so I felt like that night I could too, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说：“我以前在哈德逊河遇到过这种危险情况，每次都能化险为夷，所以我当时觉得那天晚上我也能做到。”

sentences.en: You know how you get careless?
sentences.zh: 你知道人是怎么变得大意的吗？

sentences.en: I was careless.
sentences.zh: 我太大意了。

sentences.en: So was he.
sentences.zh: 他也是。

sentences.en: We both were.
sentences.zh: 我们两个都是。

sentences.en: It cost him.
sentences.zh: 这让他付出了代价。

sentences.en: It cost him his life.
sentences.zh: 这让他付出了生命。

sentences.en: Angelica's supporters have compared her case to that of Amanda Knox, who was accused of murdering Meredith Kircher, as detailed in episode 270 of Case File.
sentences.zh: 安杰丽卡的支持者将她的案子与阿曼达·诺克斯的案子进行了对比，后者曾被指控谋杀梅雷迪思·基舍尔，正如《Case File》第270集所详细讲述的那样。

sentences.en: While Vincent's case lacked the same gruesome sexualised violence as Meredith's.
sentences.zh: 虽然文森特的案子不像梅雷迪思的案子那样包含骇人听闻的性暴力。

sentences.en: Both involved women accused of murder who were heavily scrutinised and judged based on their unconventional emotional responses,
sentences.zh: 但两起案件都涉及被指控谋杀的女性，她们受到了严厉的审视，并根据她们非传统的出格情感反应、

sentences.en: body language, personality traits, and cultural differences.
sentences.zh: 肢体语言、性格特征和文化差异而被评判。

sentences.en: Elle magazine explored why such cases capture public attention, with their articles stating,
sentences.zh: 《Elle》杂志探讨了为什么此类案件会引起公众的关注，其文章写道：

sentences.en: When women stand accused in the death of a loved one, stereotypes about how they should act intervene.
sentences.zh: 当女性被指控涉嫌谋杀亲人时，关于她们“应该”如何行事的刻板印象便会介入。

sentences.en: Alleged female criminals receive more gender-based media coverage than their male counterparts, fuelling the news cycle, poisoning public opinion, and making it harder
sentences.zh: 与男性同行相比，被指控犯罪的女性会受到更多基于性别的媒体报道，从而煽动新闻周期、毒害公众舆论，并使人更难

sentences.en: to find impartial juries.
sentences.zh: 找到公正的陪审团。

sentences.en: As a result, women are often judged for two crimes, whether they committed the alleged crime and whether they failed in their traditional caregiving role.
sentences.zh: 因此，女性经常要接受两项罪名的审判：她们是否犯下了被指控的罪行，以及她们是否没有尽到传统的照顾职责。

sentences.en: Since Vincent's death, Angelica has largely kept a low profile, speaking about the aftermath of the controversial case in only a few interviews.
sentences.zh: 自从文森特去世以来，安杰丽卡一直保持低调，仅在少数几次采访中谈及这起充满争议的案件的后续影响。

sentences.en: She says that she continues to kayak and has even returned to Bannerman's Island, describing it as a way of confronting her fear and completing the circle.
sentences.zh: 她称自己仍在玩皮划艇，甚至曾重返班纳曼岛，并将其描述为直面恐惧和完成闭环的一种方式。

sentences.en: In August 2015, four months after Vincent Villafor's death, 32-year-old photographer
sentences.zh: 2015年8月，在文森特·维亚福尔去世四个月后，32岁的摄影师

sentences.en: and model Ian Jones and his 22-year-old girlfriend, Tarly Lennox Fruchtman, attended a night-long birthday party at a Hudson River waterfront mansion.
sentences.zh: 兼模特伊安·琼斯与他22岁女友塔莉·伦诺克斯·弗鲁赫特曼参加了在哈德逊河滨水豪宅举办的通宵生日派对。
zh_words: 塔莉·伦诺克斯·弗鲁赫特曼

sentences.en: The couple, who had been together for two years and considered each other their perfect match, were planning to wed.
sentences.zh: 这对情侣已经在一起两年了，彼此视对方为绝配，并正计划结婚。

sentences.en: The morning after the party, they decided to go for a romantic kayak trip together.
sentences.zh: 派对结束后的早晨，他们决定一起进行一次浪漫的皮划艇之旅。

sentences.en: The couple climbed into a two-seater kayak and headed toward a distant lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 两人登上了一艘双人皮划艇，朝着远处的灯塔划去。

sentences.en: Ian, a strong swimmer with experience in kayaking, considered the trip low risk.
sentences.zh: 伊安是一名游泳健将，有着丰富的皮划艇经验，他认为这次旅行风险很低。

sentences.en: It was summertime, the water was calm, and Ian was doing all the paddling.
sentences.zh: 当时正值盛夏，水面平静，而且划桨的活全由伊安包揽。

sentences.en: Neither he nor Tali wore life jackets.
sentences.zh: 他和塔莉都没有穿救生衣。

sentences.en: During their journey, the kayak was caught in a current in the middle of the river and capsized.
sentences.zh: 在他们的旅程中，皮划艇在河中央卷入了一股水流中并翻了船。

sentences.en: Neither Ian nor Tali fully understood the deceptive danger of the river.
sentences.zh: 伊安和塔莉都没有完全意识到这条河暗藏的危险。

sentences.en: The current, moving at four miles per hour, swept Ian away.
sentences.zh: 以每小时四英里速度移动的水流将伊安冲走了。

sentences.en: Two days later, his body was found near the Poughkeepsie Yacht Club
sentences.zh: 两天后，他的尸体在波基普西游艇俱乐部附近被发现。

sentences.en: Tali, who was picked up by a passing boat, later said that Ian died trying to save her She was an emotional wreck after the experience, posting a heartfelt tribute on social media
sentences.zh: 塔莉被一艘路过的船只救起，她后来称伊安是为了救她而死的。经历此事后她情绪崩溃，在社交媒体上发布了一则深情的悼词：

sentences.en: My heart is shattered, my best friend, my soulmate, my partner in crime and creativity the love and delight of my life, is no longer with me.
sentences.zh: 我的心碎了，我的挚友、我的灵魂伴侣、我犯罪与创意的搭档——我生命中的挚爱与快乐，已经不在我身边了。

sentences.en: Ian Jones's death was immediately considered a tragic accident.
sentences.zh: 伊安·琼斯的死立即被认为是一起悲惨的意外。

sentences.en: No foul play was suspected and the matter wasn't investigated further by police.
sentences.zh: 警方未怀疑存在谋杀嫌疑，因此也没有对该事件作进一步调查。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Angelica Graswold remained in prison, awaiting trial for the murder of Vincent Villafor.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，安杰丽卡·格拉斯沃德仍在狱中，等待因谋杀文森特·维亚福尔而接受审判。
